checks.description: End-to-end: start from a code mission that organically requires research, a competing alternative, QA and Handoff; confirm the final graph tells that actual history clearly.
After mission completion, confirm non-ephemeral history remains inspectable while ephemeral one-shot agents are absent.
Review one multi-day/long-running style simulated mission and confirm nested Mission Owners are understandable without presenting Mission Owner as a role.
Review final representative report/comparison artifacts and approve visual/presentation quality.

rule: Human validation may only be marked passed by an actual human execution; QA agents record evidence but do not self-approve Human checks.
